extDescription.message: Passes the figures on your Claude, GPT and Gemini usage pages to the menu bar on this Mac.

popupIntro.message: Check that this is the Chrome profile and account you want to connect. Web connections need no terminal tools.

autoRefreshNote.message: When off, no usage tabs are opened in the background. Press “Refresh now” below when you need a reading.

accountPlaceholder.message: Leave blank for the current account

footnote.message: With automatic checks on, readings refresh every 10 minutes using the account signed in to Chrome. Usage figures are passed to this Mac. For Gemini, the email is also stored locally to verify the account. GPT is the plan usage from ChatGPT settings; check the usage page for which features count.

geminiLoginRequired.message: Sign in to Gemini in Chrome.

geminiAccountMismatch.message: Chrome is using a different Google account from the one you pinned.

geminiUnavailable.message: Could not read usage. Open the page below and check that you are signed in and usage is shown.

geminiHostUnavailable.message: The menu bar app is not connected. Press Connect Chrome… in the app's Settings.

usingSignedIn.message: Uses whichever account is signed in to Chrome.

invalidEmail.message: That is not a valid email address.

webUnavailable.message: Could not read usage. Check the Chrome login and usage page.

webHostUnavailable.message: Press Connect Chrome… in the app's Settings, then reload the extension.

webIdle.message: Turn the connection on to check with the current Chrome login.
